info.title: API.SH: SpyFu
info.description: The SpyFu API from API.SH: public SpyFu data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Backlinks pointing to a domain, or to the pages that rank for a keyword: linking URL and domain, domain strength, the linking domain's and page's monthly organic clicks, keywords the page ranks for and its outbound links. Pass either `domain` or `keyword`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spyfu-backlinks

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain to find backlinks for (or pass `keyword`).

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword whose ranking pages' backlinks to list (or pass `domain`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country database: US (default), UK (GB accepted), AR, AT, AU, BE, BR, CA, CH, CL, CZ, DE, DK, ES, FI, FR, IE, IN, IT, JP, MX, NL, NO, NZ, PL, PT, SE, SG, TR, UA, VE, ZA.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip; pass `next_offset` back here. Null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A domain's latest SEO and PPC numbers from SpyFu: organic keywords, estimated monthly organic clicks and their value, average organic rank, paid keywords, monthly paid clicks, estimated monthly Google Ads budget, average ad position and domain strength; counts of newly ranked, gained and lost keywords; the countries SpyFu has data for; and the top organic and paid competitors with shared keywords. Unknown domains answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spyfu-domain

get.summary: SpyFu organic keywords of a domain
get.description:
The keywords a domain ranks for in Google: keyword, position and change, ranking URL, search volume, estimated SEO clicks and change, difficulty, cost per click, click split (mobile/desktop, paid/organic/no click), SERP features. Lists: most valuable, newly ranked, gained or lost ranks, gained or lost clicks, just made page one, just fell off page one, almost there (positions 11-20). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spyfu-organic-keywords

The keywords a domain buys Google Ads on: keyword, ad position, search volume, cost per click (broad, phrase, exact) and estimated monthly cost, click split, number of advertisers, SERP features and the advertisers at each ad position. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spyfu-paid-keywords

get.summary: SpyFu Google results for a keyword
get.description:
The organic Google results SpyFu recorded for a keyword (usually the top 50-100): position and change, domain, URL, page title, the domain's number of appearances, estimated monthly clicks and click value; plus a summary (difficulty, homepages, gov/edu sites, titles and URLs containing the keyword, domain diversity).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spyfu-serp

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
